description:
Plumb streaming through the adapter-contract surface per ARCH §4.4. Builds on ball bl-64cf (raw client streaming) and bl-bf79 (harness wire types).

=== Scope ===
- Request gains stream: bool (defaults false). When true, run_complete emits a JSON-Lines event stream on stdout.
- Events are the §4.4 normalized shape — NOT Anthropic's native SSE: message_start, content_block_start, text_delta, tool_use_delta, content_block_stop, message_stop. The adapter translates Anthropic's content_block_delta into text_delta / tool_use_delta based on block type.
- Terminal message_stop carries usage (full Anthropic-native field names) and api_calls (integer ≥1 — count of HTTP requests the adapter made under this complete invocation; for this adapter always 1 unless retry lands later).
- `ping` events from Anthropic are dropped (§4.4 doesn't define them in the normalized shape).
- Errors: if streaming fails mid-flight, emit { "type": "error", "kind": "retryable"|"fatal", ... } as a final line and exit 0.
- SIGTERM: drop in-flight HTTP, flush a final message_stop or error event, exit within 5s.
- describe.capabilities += "streaming"; SCHEMA_VERSION stays on 2 (adding a request field is additive; streaming was always planned).
- Harness-side wire types (src/provider/wire.rs) grow the event variants so src/prompt can parse a streaming response into its own typed events.

=== Non-goals ===
- UI consumption of the stream (v0.5 work).
- Retry / reconnect (adapter owns retry per §4.4; for now one HTTP call per stream, api_calls=1 terminal).
- Tool-use streaming event content is reserved (shape defined, fields empty until v0.3 adds tool use).

=== Testing ===
Adapter-level integration tests: feed a mocked Anthropic SSE stream through run_complete with stream: true, assert JSON-Lines normalized output. SIGTERM test: start a stream, signal, assert a terminal event and exit within timeout. 100% tarpaulin.
title: Adapter contract: streaming wire in run_complete
